data.review_guide_step_1: Look at the word (or listen to it) and try to recall its meaning.
data.review_guide_step_2: Tap the card to flip it and check the meaning and the example.
data.review_guide_step_3: Grade honestly how well you remembered it – the app schedules the next review from your answer.
data.review_guide_tip: Be honest: pressing Easy on a word you barely know only makes you forget it. When in doubt, choose Good.
data.review_guide_why_body: Every word you learn becomes a card. Instead of reviewing everything every day, the app only shows the cards you are about to forget. Words you know well come back less and less often (3 days, a week, a month…), while hard words come back sooner. A few minutes a day is enough to remember words for the long term.
